description: SRV-CLI-008: `--single` SPA fallback. Per third_party/serve/source/main.ts:78-90 the CLI prepends a synthetic rewrite `{source: '**', destination: '/index.html'}` to the user's rewrites at config-load time, then runs the standard phase-7 rewrite pipeline. Three anchors: `spa_root` (GET / serves index.html via the catch-all), `spa_deep` (deep extensionless path served by the same rule), `spa_with_existing_html` (has-extension request whose original file exists — pre-stat asymmetry per openspec/specs/rewrites/spec.md:24-26 means the file is served directly, NOT replaced by the synthetic rewrite). cleanUrls is explicitly disabled in serve.json to isolate phase-7 behavior; with cleanUrls on (the default), the existing-html anchor would 301 via phase 4 instead of testing the pre-stat asymmetry.
